title: Who Gave Me Tequila?? With Our First Ever Special Guest!!
description: We had our first ever guest - our girl Lauren! - and since we're all three bartenders, our Sips of the Week were fresh strawberry margaritas handcrafted by Laur herself. It quickly turned into a little midday margarita madness and the giggles were flowing. No exact recipe on the episode, so here's a solid baseline.
name: fresh strawberry margaritas handcrafted by Laur herself. Let’s just say… it quickly turned into a little midday margarita madness and the giggles were flowing
ingredients: tequila; fresh lime juice; orange liqueur; fresh strawberries; agave syrup (optional); salt for rim (optional)
method: Muddle 3-4 fresh strawberries in a shaker. Add 2 oz tequila, 1 oz fresh lime juice, 1 oz orange liqueur, and a small splash of agave if you like it sweeter. Shake hard with ice and strain into a salt-rimmed glass over fresh ice.
